command_argv: --test-name-pattern=accepts complete|preserves the default|rejects (duplicate success key|duplicate error key|duplicate nested issue key|missing completeness|internal execution timeout|internal creation timeout|hidden report exception|logged error|missing serialized report)
fixture_compatibility: Only for the original runner, provide MYTHRIL_COMPLETENESS_FILE as a temporary unused output path so the new upstream mock can emit sidecar bytes without crashing. scope: Original published runner plus recovered original upstream tests. Selected regressions and controls only; unselected cases are not a pass.
